item_name: Rothco Don't Tread On Me Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco's Don't Tread On Me Low Profile Cap brings the historic symbol of the Gadsden Flag to life. This iconic yellow coiled rattlesnake and the bold "Don't Tread On Me" lettering, dating back to the American Revolution, are intricately embroidered on the front of the patriotic cap. The lightweight and durable brushed cotton twill material ensures long-lasting wear, while the internal sweatband provides superior comfort by keeping moisture away from your eyes. With 4 reinforced vent holes, the baseball hat allows for better airflow.
description: Rothco's Don't Tread On Me Low Profile Cap brings the historic symbol of the Gadsden Flag to life. This iconic yellow coiled rattlesnake and the bold "Don't Tread On Me" lettering, dating back to the American Revolution, are intricately embroidered on the front of the patriotic cap. The lightweight and durable brushed cotton twill material ensures long-lasting wear, while the internal sweatband provides superior comfort by keeping moisture away from your eyes. With 4 reinforced vent holes, the baseball hat allows for better airflow, keeping your head cool in any situation. Designed to fit most head sizes, the low profile cap features an adjustable hook & loop strap on the back for a perfect fit. This outdoor cap combines classic style with patriotic symbolism, making it a great addition to your wardrobe. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
